module.purpose: Implements the React Fiber host configuration for react-test-renderer, providing mock DOM node creation, mutation, and no-op stubs for persistence, hydration, view transitions, and suspended commits so components can be rendered to a plain JS tree in tests.
module.summary: This module is the reconciler host config for the React test renderer. It exports a large set of functions that the React reconciler calls to create, append, insert, remove, and mutate mock instance and text nodes represented as plain objects. It also provides no-op implementations for features not needed in tests (hydration, persistence, test selectors, microtasks, resources, singletons, view transitions, gestures, suspended commits). A WeakMap maps mock nodes created via createNodeMock back to internal instances. Flow types describe the shape of containers, instances, and text instances. The file is essentially a function bag with no classes, where most behaviors are either simple object mutations or empty stubs.
module.businessContext: Enables React component testing without a real DOM. If broken, react-test-renderer cannot build or commit component trees, breaking the testing ecosystem.
functions: getPublicInstance (~L73-88): Returns mock node for instance or instance itself
appendChild (~L90-109): Appends child to parent removing existing duplicate

detail.name: startViewTransition
detail.signature: export function startViewTransition(suspendedState: null | SuspendedState, rootContainer: Container, transitionTypes: null | TransitionTypes, mutationCallback: () => void, layoutCallback: () => void, afterMutationCallback: () => void, spawnedWorkCallback: () => void, passiveCallback: () => mixed, errorCallback: mixed => void, blockedCallback: string => void, finishedAnimation: () => void): null | RunningViewTransition
preconditions: mutationCallback, layoutCallback, spawnedWorkCallback are callable functions
suspendedState is null or SuspendedState
rootContainer is a Container
postconditions: mutationCallback called exactly once
layoutCallback called exactly once
spawnedWorkCallback called exactly once
return value is null
edgeCases: afterMutationCallback, passiveCallback, errorCallback, blockedCallback, finishedAnimation are never invoked regardless of input
if any of mutationCallback, layoutCallback, or spawnedWorkCallback throws, subsequent callbacks in sequence are not called and error propagates

raises: Exceptions thrown by mutationCallback, layoutCallback, or spawnedWorkCallback propagate

detail.summary: Immediately invokes mutation, layout, and spawned-work callbacks in order and returns null, deliberately skipping after-mutation, passive, error, blocked, and finished-animation callbacks to provide a non-animating view transition stub.

specTests.when: startViewTransition(null, {}, null, mutationCallback, layoutCallback, afterMutationCallback, spawnedWorkCallback, passiveCallback, errorCallback, blockedCallback, finishedAnimation) is called
specTests.then: mutationCallback, layoutCallback, spawnedWorkCallback each called exactly once; afterMutationCallback, passiveCallback, errorCallback, blockedCallback, finishedAnimation not called; return value is null

postconditions: mutationCallback has been called exactly once

detail.summary: Invokes the provided mutation and animation callbacks immediately, conditionally calls finishedAnimation when profiling is enabled, and always returns null. Serves as a stub for starting a gesture transition in the test renderer.

detail.name: getInstanceFromScope
detail.signature: export function getInstanceFromScope(scopeInstance: Object): null | Object
postconditions: Returns the internal instance object stored for the provided scopeInstance via nodeToInstanceMap.
Returns null if no instance is registered for the given scopeInstance.
edgeCases: When nodeToInstanceMap does not contain an entry for scopeInstance, the function returns null.
When scopeInstance is a valid key in nodeToInstanceMap, the corresponding instance is returned.
detail.summary: Retrieves the internal instance associated with a given scope instance from the node-to-instance map, returning null if no mapping exists. Used to resolve scope-based instance references during reconciliation.

detail.name: preloadInstance
detail.signature: export function preloadInstance(instance: Instance, type: Type, props: Props): boolean
postconditions: Returns the boolean value true on every invocation.
edgeCases: Regardless of the values passed for instance, type, or props, the function always returns true.
The function performs no validation or side effects on its arguments.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No error handling; invalid inputs are ignored.

detail.summary: A no-op host config hook for the test renderer that pretends to preload an instance by immediately returning true, signaling that the instance is already considered loaded.
